title: Athelvoid
summary: A company site with its own small content system: pages, a blog, a contact inbox, and an admin area behind a real sign-in that edits all of it.
role: Design, pages, the content model, the admin area and its sign-in.
description: Athelvoid is the site of a small software studio: home, about, services, blog and contact, with an admin area that edits all of it. Messages from the contact form land in an inbox with new, read, replied and archived states.
It is a prototype with sample content, and it is not online yet. The content is kept in one JSON file, which is enough for one server and one editor.

I reworked it in 2026. The first version checked the admin password in the browser and left the admin routes open; now sign-in is checked on the server and every admin page and route asks for it. The look was reworked as well: the same dark violet, but flat, with its own typefaces, content that is visible without scripts, and an admin area that works on a phone.

highlights.title: An admin area that is really closed
highlights.text: The password comes from the server's settings and is compared there, in constant time. The session is a signed cookie that scripts cannot read. Every admin page and route checks it, a write from another site is refused, and five wrong passwords lock sign-in for a while. With no password set, nobody gets in.

highlights.title: Checks that prove it
highlights.text: A script of 52 checks runs against the running site: every admin route without a session, wrong and right passwords, changed and expired cookies, the lock, sign-out, and the limits of the contact form. On the first version 25 of its 28 checks failed.

highlights.title: Storage that can be swapped
highlights.text: All reads and writes go through two functions. Today they use a JSON file; a database can replace it without touching the pages. Each admin section saves only its own part, so a message that arrives while the admin area is open is not lost.

highlights.title: One typed content model
highlights.text: Posts, services, projects, team and the about page share one typed model with seed data, and everything that is saved is checked against it first.

highlights.title: Design tokens
highlights.text: Colours, spacing and type are CSS custom properties. There is one animation, when a page loads, and it is switched off for visitors who ask their system for less motion.
